newsitem.title: GERMANY: Didier-Werke sees higher 96 group profit.
newsitem.headline: Didier-Werke sees higher 96 group profit.

text.p: Germany's Didier-Werke AG said on Wednesday it expected a rise in group profit in 1996 and also expected to remain in profit at parent company level.

Didier, a manufacturer of blast furnace linings and other high-temparature technology, said group sales fell three percent to 968 million marks in the first nine months of 1996 while group pre-tax profit fell to eight million marks, from 12 million in the year-earlier period.
The group said it remained profitable at parent company level during the first nine months and predicted that it would post a profit at the parent level for the full year as well.
The company is owned by Austria's Radex-Heraklith Industrie-beteiligings-AG.
In 1995, Didier increased its group pretax profit to 20.7 million marks from 2.5 million in 1994.
